scenarios.scenario: Filter the model browser by a feature name

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible block made by an extrusion named Extrusion1
the model browser shows its normal hierarchy
the user opens browser search and enters "Extrusion"
the browser shows matching extrusion rows and their ancestor hierarchy
unrelated origin rows are absent from the filtered tree
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user clears the search text
the normal model hierarchy returns
the user closes browser search
the search field disappears
the normal hierarchy remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Collapse and expands all browser branches

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a visible block made by an extrusion
its browser has expanded representation, origin and extrusion branches
the user opens the model browser menu and chooses Collapse All
the top-level branches remain visible with their children hidden
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user opens the model browser menu and chooses Expand All
the origin planes and the nested extrusion sketch are visible
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Toggle extended feature names in the browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a 20 mm new-solid extrusion
Show Extended Names is disabled in the model browser display preferences
the user enables Show Extended Names from the browser display preferences
the extrusion row includes its new-solid operation and 20 mm extent after its name
the block remains visible in the same apparent view
the user reopens the browser display preferences
Show Extended Names is checked
the user chooses Show Extended Names again
the extrusion row returns to its shorter name
the block remains visible in the same apparent view

scenarios.scenario: Inspect a nested sketch from the model browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains a dimensioned rectangular sketch used by an extrusion
the extrusion branch is expanded in the model browser
the user right-clicks the nested sketch row
the sketch row is highlighted
its rectangular geometry and dimensions appear highlighted in the viewport
the sketch context menu offers Edit Sketch, Redefine, Share Sketch and Properties
the menu offers Visibility and Export Sketch As
the user dismisses the menu and clears the selection
the highlighted sketch geometry and dimensions disappear from the viewport
the solid remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Cancel a sketch line style change

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a dimensioned sketch is nested under an extrusion in the MCAD Software
the sketch line type is Default
the user opens Properties from the sketch row context menu
the geometry properties dialog shows line color, line type and line weight controls
the line type field displays Default
Apply is disabled
the user chooses Dashed as the line type
the line type field displays Dashed and Apply is enabled
the user clicks Cancel and reopens the sketch properties
the line type field displays Default
the user clicks Cancel
the properties dialog closes

scenarios.scenario: Show and hide an origin axis from its browser menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded and the X Axis is hidden
the user right-clicks the X Axis row
the row is highlighted and the axis is highlighted in blue in the viewport
Visibility is unchecked and Auto Resize is checked in the context menu
the user chooses Visibility and clicks empty viewport space
the axis remains visible as a line beside the block
the user right-clicks the X Axis row again
Visibility is checked in the context menu
the user chooses Visibility again
the axis is hidden and the block remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Navigate the origin branch with arrow keys

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded with its origin planes hidden
the user selects the YZ Plane row in the model browser
the YZ plane is highlighted in the viewport
the user presses Down Arrow
the XZ Plane row is selected and the XZ plane is highlighted
the YZ plane highlight is removed
the user presses Up Arrow
the YZ Plane row is selected and the YZ plane is highlighted again
the user presses Left Arrow
the Origin parent row is selected and the plane highlight is removed
the user presses Left Arrow again
the Origin branch collapses and its children are hidden
the user presses Right Arrow
the Origin branch expands and its children are visible
the user presses Right Arrow again
the YZ Plane row is selected and the YZ plane is highlighted
the user clicks empty viewport space
the plane highlight disappears and the block remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Move between origin planes with Shift and Down Arrow

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software
the Origin branch is expanded and its planes are hidden
the YZ Plane row is selected and its plane is highlighted
the user presses Shift and Down Arrow together
the XZ Plane row is selected and its plane is highlighted
the YZ plane is no longer highlighted
the user presses Shift and Down Arrow together again
the XY Plane row is selected and its plane is highlighted
the XZ plane is no longer highlighted
the user clicks empty viewport space
the plane highlight disappears and the block remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Find an extrusion by feature type

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
an active part in the MCAD Software contains one extrusion forming a block
the model browser is visible
the Find criteria list is empty
the user chooses Find from the model browser menu
the user selects Features as the object type
the user selects Type as the property and Extrusion as the value
the condition displays equals
the user clicks Add to list
the criteria list contains Type equals Extrusion
the user clicks Find Now
the extrusion row is selected in the model browser
the visible edges of the block are highlighted in blue
the Find dialog remains open
the user closes the dialog
the extrusion remains selected and the block edges remain highlighted
the user clicks empty viewport space
the selection highlight disappears and the block remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Group search criteria for the same feature property

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part with one extrusion and no fillet is open in the MCAD Software
the Find dialog contains the criterion Type equals Extrusion
Features is the selected object type and And is selected for additional criteria
the user chooses Type equals Fillet and clicks Add to list
a prompt says criteria using the same property must be grouped
the prompt offers to add the criterion using the OR operator
the user chooses Yes
the criteria list shows Type equals Extrusion
the next line shows OR Type equals Fillet
the user closes and reopens the Find dialog
both criteria remain in the list
the user clicks Find Now
the extrusion row is selected and the block edges are highlighted
the Find dialog remains open
the user closes the Find dialog and clicks empty viewport space
the highlight disappears and the part remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Cancel a sketch line weight change

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a nested sketch in the MCAD Software has Default line weight
the user opens Properties from the sketch row context menu
the user opens the Line Weight list
the list shows Default and numeric millimeter weights with line samples
0.25 mm is available
the user chooses 0.25 mm
the Line Weight field displays 0.25 mm and Apply is enabled
the user clicks Cancel and reopens the sketch properties
the Line Weight field displays Default and Apply is disabled
the user clicks Cancel
the properties dialog closes
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a nested sketch in the MCAD Software has Default line type
its geometry properties dialog is open with Scale unchecked
the scale value is shown as 1.00 and its field is disabled
the user checks Scale
the scale field is enabled and shows 1.00
Apply is enabled
the user clears Scale
the scale field is disabled and still shows 1.00
the user clicks Cancel
the geometry properties dialog closes
`fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part in the MCAD Software contains a rectangular sketch on the XY plane used by one extrusion
the sketch references the center point
the user chooses Relationships from the sketch row context menu
the Relationships dialog identifies the sketch as the selected item
its Parents list contains the XY plane and center point
its Children list contains the extrusion
the user selects the XY plane in the Parents list
the XY plane row is highlighted in the model browser
the plane is highlighted in the viewport
the user selects the extrusion in the Children list
the extrusion row and its solid edges are highlighted
the user activates the navigation control beside the extrusion
the dialog identifies the extrusion as the selected item
its Parents list contains the XY plane and the sketch
its Children list is empty
the user activates the navigation control beside the sketch in the Parents list
the dialog identifies the sketch as the selected item again
its Children list contains the extrusion
the user clicks Done
the Relationships dialog closes

scenarios.scenario: Navigate relationships from an origin plane

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a part in the MCAD Software contains a sketch on the XY plane and an extrusion using that sketch
the user chooses Relationships from the XY plane row context menu
the dialog identifies the XY plane as the selected item
the Parents list is empty
the Children list contains the sketch and the extrusion
the user activates the navigation control beside the sketch
the sketch becomes the selected item in the dialog
the Parents list contains the XY plane and center point
the Children list contains the extrusion
the user activates the navigation control beside the XY plane
the XY plane becomes the selected item again
the Parents list is empty
the Children list contains the sketch and the extrusion
the user clicks Done
the Relationships dialog closes
